name: Rampaging Giants
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Around 4,000 years ago, Tyrande Whisperwind saved the life of the frostsaber queen, at the hands of rampaging giants. Since then, the frostsabers have been allies of the night elves.

These same giants that once were a danger to the frostsabers, still exist not too far from here. They are called the frostmaul, and they have taken over the large valley to the south.

Prove your loyalty to the frostsabers; kill these giants in the name of the frostsaber queen, Shy-Rotam!
narrative.objectives: Rivern Frostwind wants you to kill 4 Frostmaul Giants and 4 Frostmaul Preservers.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent, adventurer. Your determination has been duly noted.
narrative.requestItemsText: You must continue to prove yourself, adventurer.
